title: Non-pressure ulcer depth and burn extent
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the ulcer, or for the burn extent (T31) when the note is about a burn (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for a chronic wound on the right heel.

HPI: The patient is a 67-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding a chronic ulcer located on the right heel. He reports that the area has remained stable over the past few weeks with no new drainage or signs of increasing pain. He admits to occasional discomfort when walking but denies any fever, chills, or systemic malaise. He has been diligent with his home care but notes that the wound is slow to heal. He denies any new symptoms or changes in the appearance of the site since his last visit.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg daily
- Atorvastatin 20mg daily
- Amlodipine 5mg daily

Review of Systems:
The patient denies fever, chills, cough, or shortness of breath. He denies chest pain, palpitations, or syncope. He denies polyuria, polydipsia, or blurred vision. He denies joint pain or recent changes in mobility. He denies any new numbness or tingling in his extremities.

Social History: The patient is a retired construction worker. He lives with his wife and reports being a non-smoker. He enjoys walking for exercise and gardening.

Family History: His father had a history of hypertension and his mother had a history of hyperlipidemia.

Vitals:
BP: 132/82 mmHg
HR: 74 bpm
Temp: 98.6 F
RR: 16 breaths/min
SpO2: 98% on room air

Recent Labs:
HbA1c: 6.8%
eGFR: 72 mL/min/1.73m2
WBC: 8.2 x 10^9/L

Exam:
The patient is a well-appearing male in no acute distress. Physical exam reveals a non-pressure chronic ulcer of the right heel. The wound bed is primarily granulating with minimal surrounding erythema. There is no purulent drainage noted at this time. Peripheral pulses are palpable and symmetric. Capillary refill is less than 3 seconds.

Assessment:
1. Chronic ulcer of the right heel.

Plan:
The patient will continue with the current wound care regimen. I will provide instructions for dressing changes and signs of infection to monitor at home. We will proceed with a plan for continued wound care and will reassess the site in two weeks.

Electronically signed, 
P. O'Brien, PA-C
May 14, 2026
explanations: Non-pressure chronic ulcer of right heel and midfoot, severity not stated: L97.419 (HCC 383).

hccs.label: Chronic Ulcer of Skin/Except Pressure/Not Specified as Through to Bone or Muscle
